scope: Pack only the 512-wide non-RoPE GLM compact latent. Keep the 64-wide RoPE cache, indexer cache, weights, routing, selected-ID order, and all non-GLM paths unchanged.

format.scale_rule: max(abs(block))/6, or 1 for an all-zero block
format.rounding: nearest midpoint with lower code on an exact midpoint

production_path_red: unchanged engine has no exact DS4_GLM_COMPACT_CACHE_E2M1 selector
unchanged store kernels cannot emit the packed 320-byte row
unchanged attention readers cannot consume the packed representation

required: packed bytes and decoded float32 values match an independent CPU reference for finite randomized, zero, signed-zero, midpoint, saturation, ragged-row, and canary cases
all production store paths increment a format-specific row counter and every compact-latent reader increments a format-specific value counter
the candidate allocates exactly 320 bytes per 512-value latent row while RoPE and indexer allocation are byte-unchanged
unset and explicit-zero arms are byte-identical and execute no E2M1 store/read counter
microgate.failure: Any mismatch, uncovered reader/store path, canary write, non-finite result, malformed flag acceptance, or storage-ratio mismatch is FAIL.

requirements: one-sided 95% upper bound for delta NLL <= 0.01
one-sided 95% upper bound for top-1 loss <= 0.005
candidate is deterministic with itself run-to-run
fidelity_gate.adoption_authority: Passing statistical limits does not authorize adoption. Report the nonzero fidelity delta with measured memory/performance purchase to the owner.

serving_gate: Only after microgate review and fidelity PASS: matched contained arms must demonstrate the intended memory reduction, complete output, no OOM/Xid/swap/survivor, and no decode or TTFT regression beyond preregistered bounds.
context_gate: Only after serving and fidelity gates: direct cap 1048576 with at least 1000000 actual input tokens, deterministic multi-position retrieval plus negative controls, completed generation with max_tokens >= 64, and at least 10 GiB MemAvailable at the low point.
